sekcje: Drug Levels and Effects > Summary of Use during Lactation

No information is available on the clinical use of sotagliflozin during breastfeeding. Sotagliflozin is over 93% protein bound in plasma, so it is unlikely to pass into breastmilk in clinically important amounts. The manufacturer does not recommend sotagliflozin during breastfeeding. An alternate drug may be preferred, especially while nursing a newborn or preterm infant.
